newsitem.title: USA: Iron Mountain to acquire management firm.
newsitem.headline: Iron Mountain to acquire management firm.

text.p: Iron Mountain Inc said Thursday it had reached a definitive agreement to acquire Safesite Records Management Corp for stock and cash.
Under the deal, Safesite shareholders are to receive about $50 million in Iron Mountain stock plus $12 million cash.
The number of Iron Mountain shares to be issued will be determined based on the stock's market price, using a floor of $26 per share and a ceiling of $31.
The merger is expected to be completed during the second quarter, Iron Mountain said.
Safesite is based in Boston. Iron Mountain also is a record management company.
